title: Wynncraft + Optimized
description: Modpack to play Wynncraft the optimized way. All important Wynncraft Utils and optimized mods.
body:
Wynncraft + Optimized is a lightweight, performance-focused Minecraft modpack built specifically for adventurers exploring the Wynncraft RPG server. Based on the renowned Fabulously Optimized modpack, it delivers smooth gameplay, improved visuals, and enhanced stability without sacrificing compatibility with the Wynncraft experience.
At its core is Wynntils, the essential companion mod for Wynncraft players, providing powerful quality-of-life features such as better quest menu, map and many other tools. Alongside Wynntils, this pack includes carefully selected utility mods and performance improvements to make your journey across the provinces of Wynncraft more enjoyable and responsive.

Features:
-  Optimized specifically for the Wynncraft RPG server
-  Built on the performance-focused Fabulously Optimized foundation
-  Includes Wynntils for enhanced Wynncraft gameplay and navigation
-  Useful quality-of-life utilities for questing, exploration, and combat
-  Improved FPS, reduced loading times, and better overall stability
-  Lightweight and easy to install, with minimal unnecessary additions

Wynncraft + Optimized provides the tools and performance enhancements needed to get the most out of your Wynncraft experience. Focus on the adventure, the modpack handles the rest.
